snippet.title: I Tried to Build a DarkOrbit Killer… My First Game
snippet.description:
I've always wanted to make my own game, and this is my first real attempt.

After 10 years of backend development, I decided to build my own online space MMORPG from scratch.

Meet Warpscape — a sci-fi online MMORPG inspired by classic space games like DarkOrbit, but built with my own vision.

In this first teaser, I want to show you what I've been working on, the ships, the world, the combat and the overall direction of the game.

🚀 Space exploration
⚔️ PvP & PvE
🛸 Different ships
🌌 Massive space battles
⛏️ Resources and upgrades
👥 Multiplayer & clans
🎮 Built solo with Godot

This is only the beginning.


#Warpscape #DarkOrbit #SpaceMMORPG #MMORPG #SpaceGame #Godot #IndieGameDev #SoloDev #GameDev #IndieGame #SciFiGame #MultiplayerGame
